description: React component for a modal that allows users to reset or change their status (e.g., Away, Do not disturb, Offline, Online, Out of office) in Mattermost. It manages user status updates, preferences, and displays confirmation dialogs.

classes.name: ResetStatusModal
classes.description: React component class for the reset status modal dialog, handling user status changes and preferences.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches current user status on component mount and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: hideModal
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Handles user confirmation, updates status, and saves preferences if checked.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation, resets preferences if checked.

methods.name: renderModalMessage
methods.description: Renders the appropriate message in the modal based on user status.
